articles.summary: GROSSE POINTE FARMS, Mich., April 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Saga Communications, Inc. (Nasdaq: SGA) announced today that it will release its 1 st Quarter 2026 Earnings results at 9:00 a.m. EDT on Thursday, May 7, 2026. The company will be holding a conference call on the same date at 11:00 a.m.
articles.title: Saga Communications, Inc. Announces Date and Time of 1st Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
